messages:
sasha: FYI CI alert from last night's run — post-rewrite of the eval-harness, pass@k on the quantized 7B model shifted up ~6% while exact_match dropped. Dashboard shows higher pass@k than local runner. Repro steps and logs below.

ben: Can you paste the failing diff + the CI job id?

sasha: job: https://ci.internal/2378, excerpt:
```
INFO: run 482: k=5 pass@k=0.48
...expected pass@k=0.42
```
Also local run (same checkpoints): pass@k=0.42. Suspect sampling change in new runner.

clara: We changed the top-k sampler earlier — maybe it doesn't dedupe candidates before scoring. If duplicates are allowed pass@k goes up. Sasha, can you try forcing unique candidates?

sasha: quick test forcing uniqueness in python runner:
```
cands = list(dict.fromkeys(cands))  # preserve order, drop dups
```
Result: local pass@k matches new harness. So duplicate candidates were counted.

jon: That explains it. Also saw that BLEU numbers jumped when we upgraded sacrebleu — tokenization changed. Two problems in one deploy.

ben: Action items:
- add a unit test that asserts pass@k contract for a small synthetic set (seeded) — prevents dup bug.
- pin sacrebleu tokenization mode in requirements or adapt scoring wrapper.

clara: I'll open PR to add candidate dedupe (edge-case safe) + unit. Proposed patch: https://git.internal/r/8912

sasha: Also BERTScore calibration drift on quantized embeddings — norms reduced after int8 quant, causing cosine sims to shrink. Quick patch in eval: normalize embeddings before scoring (L2 norm). That restored BERTScore distribution.

jon: Nice. For CI I suggest we add a 'contract-check' job that compares current metrics to a committed baseline and fails if >X% drift. We had too many silent shifts.

eval-bot: nightly-eval (#2378) failed: metric-contract-drift > threshold (pass@k delta 0.057). See job https://ci.internal/2378

sasha: Plan: 1) merge dedupe + unit + pin sacrebleu 2) add embedding-normalize flag (defaults true) 3) add contract-check job (opt-out for experimental branches). PRs: https://git.internal/r/8912 (dedupe), https://git.internal/r/8913 (bertnorm), https://git.internal/r/8914 (ci)

ben: :eyes: Please attach small reproduction script to PRs, and add a short note in the onboarding docs about metric contract expectations.

sasha: Will do. I'll coordinate the PRs and post back when CI green. Thanks all :thumbsup:
